    SELECT elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w'::numeric as power_now,
           elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w'::numeric as power_loss
    FROM electrical_performance

)
SELECT 
    power_now as actual_usable_power,
    power_now + power_loss as gross_power,
    power_loss / (power_now + power_loss) as system_power_loss_ratio,
    (power_now + power_loss) * (1 - power_loss / (power_now + power_loss)) as effective_power_output
FROM data;
